observations: State Ownership Register and Operating Mode Matrix are named, bounded, ordered empty templates, including combined and compact views.
Record label/value first baselines align, including multiline values and empty writable lines; field spacing was not compressed.
OPERATIONAL remains whole after a pipe boundary; soft-wrap marker is visually distinguishable.
Ops final two lines are absorbed into the complete conclusion; the header is section 30 in standalone and combined views.
Method literal labels are subordinate; RACI/risk matrices remain horizontal comparison views; cover/control/TOC/index retain navigation.
No clipping, overlap, unreadable scaling or orphaned template identity observed in inspected pages.

limitations: Self-review is not independent acceptance, VISUAL_PROFILE_FROZEN or formal release.
Automated destination, text and glyph geometry checks are bounded oracles, not proof of every visual relationship or technical correctness.

The 38-field long empty-template and long-danger continuation are real-compile synthetic regressions; final source templates are short and remain whole. Synthetic pages are not included in the 50 final-image review count.
G7 Final Gate retains source formatting of standalone expressions and question marks; this batch does not rewrite or repunctuate frozen questions.
Natural whitespace at chapter openings, TOC endings and complete closing units is retained; no page-fill target is imposed.
Writable template lines are a print/read view, not interactive AcroForm fields.
No C++ experiment, performance or concurrency rerun; no accessibility certification or cross-platform renderer validation.
